The art of paying attention

AN EXERCISE IN NOTICING · 6 MIN READ

The most important thing is not how much you read, but how much you notice. Reading is a conversation with the world.

A useful idea is only the beginning. Write it down, connect it to something you know, and give it room to grow.

Reading is a conversation with the world. This time, the context is different.

Attention is a practice, not a destination. Every small observation is a way of beginning again.
